import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.LineBundleRationalSections

/-!
# Rational generators on subopens

A frame of a line bundle gives one rational generator on its entire
trivializing open and all its nonempty subopens. This compatibility allows
local equations of the associated divisor to be compared on overlaps.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite TopologicalSpace

namespace AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.LineBundle

variable {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral X]

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
omit [IsIntegral X] in
private theorem restrictIso_app_smul
    {M N : X.Modules} (W : X.Opens)
    (f : M.restrict W.ι ⟶ N.restrict W.ι) (V : W.toScheme.Opens)
    (r : Γ(X, W.ι ''ᵁ V)) (s : Γ(M, W.ι ''ᵁ V)) :
    f.app V (r • s) = r • (show Γ(N, W.ι ''ᵁ V) from f.app V s) := by
  have hM := Modules.smul_restrictAppIso_inv_apply W.ι M V r s
  have hN := Modules.smul_restrictAppIso_hom_apply W.ι N V
    ((W.ι.appIso V).hom r) (f.app V s)
  simp only [Modules.restrictAppIso, Scheme.Opens.ι_appIso, Iso.refl_hom,
    Iso.refl_inv] at hM hN
  change r • s = (show Γ(W.toScheme, V) from r) •
    (show Γ(M.restrict W.ι, V) from s) at hM
  change (show Γ(W.toScheme, V) from r) • f.app V s =
    r • (show Γ(N, W.ι ''ᵁ V) from f.app V s) at hN
  rw [hM, Modules.Hom.app_smul]
  exact hN

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- One rational generator for a trivialization generates the rational image
of its sections on every nonempty open of the trivializing chart. -/
theorem exists_rationalGenerator_on_subopens
    (L : X.Modules) (hL : IsLocallyTrivial L)
    (W : X.Opens) [Nonempty W]
    (e : L.restrict W.ι ≅ SheafOfModules.unit W.toScheme.ringCatSheaf) :
    ∃ q : X.functionField, q ≠ 0 ∧
      ∀ (V : W.toScheme.Opens) (hV : Nonempty V),
        letI : Nonempty (W.ι ''ᵁ V) :=
          ⟨⟨W.ι hV.some.val, ⟨hV.some.val, hV.some.property, rfl⟩⟩⟩
        LinearMap.range (rationalSectionLinearMap L hL (W.ι ''ᵁ V)) =
          Submodule.span Γ(X, W.ι ''ᵁ V) {q} := by
  let e' := e ≪≫ (Modules.unitRestrictIso W.ι).symm
  let t (V : W.toScheme.Opens) : Γ(L, W.ι ''ᵁ V) :=
    e'.inv.app V (show Γ(Modules.restrict (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) W.ι, V) from
      (1 : Γ(X, W.ι ''ᵁ V)))
  let htop : Nonempty (W.ι ''ᵁ (⊤ : W.toScheme.Opens)) := by
    rw [W.ι_image_top]
    infer_instance
  letI := htop
  let q := rationalSectionLinearMap L hL (W.ι ''ᵁ (⊤ : W.toScheme.Opens)) (t ⊤)
  have ht (V : W.toScheme.Opens) (s : Γ(L, W.ι ''ᵁ V)) :
      s = (show Γ(X, W.ι ''ᵁ V) from e'.hom.app V s) • t V := by
    apply (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso (e'.hom.app V)).1
    rw [restrictIso_app_smul]
    have h := congrArg
      (fun f => f.app V (show Γ(Modules.restrict (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) W.ι, V) from
        (1 : Γ(X, W.ι ''ᵁ V)))) e'.inv_hom_id
    change e'.hom.app V (t V) = (1 : Γ(X, W.ι ''ᵁ V)) at h
    rw [h]
    change (show Γ(X, W.ι ''ᵁ V) from e'.hom.app V s) =
      (show Γ(X, W.ι ''ᵁ V) from e'.hom.app V s) * 1
    exact (mul_one _).symm
  have htres (V : W.toScheme.Opens) :
      L.presheaf.map (homOfLE (W.ι.image_mono (le_top : V ≤ ⊤))).op (t ⊤) = t V := by
    have h := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
      (e'.inv.val.naturality (homOfLE (le_top : V ≤ ⊤)).op)
      (show Γ(Modules.restrict (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) W.ι, ⊤) from
        (1 : Γ(X, W.ι ''ᵁ ⊤)))
    change e'.inv.app V
        (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (W.ι.image_mono (le_top : V ≤ ⊤))).op 1) =
      L.presheaf.map (homOfLE (W.ι.image_mono (le_top : V ≤ ⊤))).op (t ⊤) at h
    rw [map_one] at h
    exact h.symm
  have hqzero : q ≠ 0 := by
    intro hq
    have hz : t ⊤ = 0 :=
      rationalSection_injective L hL _ _ (hq.trans (map_zero _).symm)
    have h := congrArg
      (fun f => f.app (⊤ : W.toScheme.Opens)
        (show Γ(Modules.restrict (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) W.ι, ⊤) from
          (1 : Γ(X, W.ι ''ᵁ ⊤)))) e'.inv_hom_id
    change e'.hom.app ⊤ (t ⊤) = (1 : Γ(X, W.ι ''ᵁ ⊤)) at h
    rw [hz, map_zero] at h
    exact (zero_ne_one : (0 : Γ(X, W.ι ''ᵁ ⊤)) ≠ 1) h
  refine ⟨q, hqzero, ?_⟩
  intro V hV
  letI : Nonempty (W.ι ''ᵁ V) :=
    ⟨⟨W.ι hV.some.val, ⟨hV.some.val, hV.some.property, rfl⟩⟩⟩
  have hqV : rationalSectionLinearMap L hL (W.ι ''ᵁ V) (t V) = q := by
    rw [← htres V]
    exact rationalSection_restrict L hL
      (W.ι.image_mono (le_top : V ≤ ⊤)) _ (t ⊤)
  ext z
  rw [LinearMap.mem_range, Submodule.mem_span_singleton]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨s, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨e'.hom.app V s, ?_⟩
    conv_rhs => rw [ht V s]
    rw [LinearMap.map_smul, hqV]
  · rintro ⟨r, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨r • t V, by rw [LinearMap.map_smul, hqV]⟩

end AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.LineBundle
